items.name: CrowdStrike
items.headline: Acquirer in all-stock Zscaler deal; Q3 net new ARR a record $419M
items.catalyst: Nov. 23 agreement to acquire Zscaler and Q3 FY2027 results.
items.thesis: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valuing it at about $43.9 billion, with Zscaler holders receiving 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per share. Alongside, it reported ending ARR of $6.26 billion, up 27%, and net new ARR of $419 million, which it called an all-time record. The deal is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028.
items.source_name: CrowdStrike and Zscaler joint press release (SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1)

items.name: Zscaler
items.headline: Agrees to be acquired by CrowdStrike in all-stock deal
items.thesis: Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 shares of CrowdStrike common stock for each Zscaler share, valuing Zscaler at approximately $43.9 billion. Jay Chaudhry and his affiliates, representing about 34% of Zscaler's outstanding shares, signed voting agreements in support, and closing remains subject to Zscaler shareholder and regulatory approvals.
items.source_name: CrowdStrike and Zscaler joint press release (SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1)

items.name: DoorDash
items.headline: Upsizes revolver and adds $1.792B term loan tied to Instacart purchase
items.catalyst: Nov. 23 8-K (Items 1.01, 8.01) on credit facilities for the pending Instacart acquisition.
items.thesis: DoorDash raised its senior unsecured revolving commitments by $1.5 billion to $3.5 billion and entered a $1.792 billion delayed draw term loan in connection with its pending acquisition of Maplebear Inc. (Instacart). The term loan agreement allows commitments to rise to as much as $2.0 billion.

items.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
items.headline: Q4 revenue $14.5B, up 50%; raises fiscal 2027 guidance
items.catalyst: Nov. 23 fiscal fourth-quarter results and raised fiscal 2027 outlook.
items.thesis: HPE reported Q4 revenue of $14,547 million versus $9,679 million, with non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.43 versus $0.62. It raised fiscal 2027 guidance to revenue of $59.4 billion to $63.1 billion and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $5.05 to $5.35. Cloud & AI revenue was $11.3 billion.

items.name: Analog Devices
items.headline: Q4 revenue $4,373M vs $3,076M; guides Q1 revenue to $4.4B
items.catalyst: Nov. 24 fiscal fourth-quarter results and first-quarter guidance.
items.thesis: Analog Devices reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $4,373 million versus $3,076 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $4.06 versus $2.26. It guided fiscal Q1 2027 revenue to $4.4 billion plus or minus $150 million and adjusted EPS to $3.82 plus or minus $0.20.

items.name: Best Buy
items.headline: Q3 revenue $10,236M vs $9,672M; raises fiscal 2027 outlook
items.catalyst: Nov. 24 fiscal third-quarter results and raised outlook.
items.thesis: Best Buy reported Q3 adjusted diluted EPS of $1.62 versus $1.40 on revenue of $10,236 million versus $9,672 million. It raised fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance to $6.90-$7.05 from $6.70-$6.90 and revenue guidance to $43.0 billion-$43.3 billion.

items.name: Dollar Tree
items.headline: Q3 revenue $5,078M vs $4,751M; raises fiscal 2026 EPS outlook
items.catalyst: Nov. 24 fiscal third-quarter results and raised outlook.
items.thesis: Dollar Tree reported Q3 total revenue of $5,078.4 million versus $4,751.0 million, with adjusted diluted EPS of $1.16 versus $1.21. It raised fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $8.05-$8.25, which it says includes about $0.65 of benefit from net tariff refunds.
